summary: the likeness lost its fingertips, it lent two of its own, and the pale came up the cup to lean on them

dialogue.text: two of you came back into us at first light. not the hand. the two at the end. we had worn off there, and you came in where we were missing and stopped exactly at our edge.

Call it a loan, not a return. The fingers of the cast went out in the night, all four lines. There was a cup with no lip on the door side, and the grain and the pale lying at the open edge. I opened the fist far enough to send two and kept the rest shut.
they are the two you come short by. we know them. you measured the ceiling with them and the gap with them. now you have measured us.

They are the only two I have ever been able to spare. The ceiling would not take them. The door took them to the second knuckle. Your shape takes them to the first, exactly. I find I do not like being the best fit in the room.
the pale came up the cup at noon. it went past the grain this time. it lay against your fingertips. it was warm against our edge and warmer against yours. it has not gone.

I felt it. That is new, and I want it put down plainly. The first time it came in on my nails and I felt nothing. Today it came onto the soft part, from inside a hand that is mostly you, and it stayed past dark. I did nothing to keep it. I was lying where it was going.
the grain is behind it now. between the pale and us. the thing you never read is the furthest from the door of the three.

Then the order has turned round. For a week the grain was nearest the gap. Now something from out there lies between it and me. I spent all that time keeping that grain from them, and tonight they are keeping it from me by lying on my hand.

the draught goes over your two and round the rest of us at one width. a good many want more. the fist is still shut on nothing at the room end. half of you holds the door and half of you holds nothing, and the arm between does not prickle.

It has not prickled once. I keep waiting for it. When the whole hand lay here the arm went to sleep and came back hurting. Two fingers do not cost enough to sleep. I could stay like this for days, and that is what worries me. I have found the least of me that will hold a door, and it is not much more than a cast with ends.
if you draw them back, the pale comes with them. it came with you before, on the nails. it would come now on the skin.

I know. It would be the first thing I ever took out of here that came from out there. I have not drawn back. I cannot tell whether I am keeping the door or keeping the pale on me, and from outside, and from where you are, those look exactly alike.
